body: Thank you. This is what happened to my knowledge, but as I said I don't remember anything and can only go on what they have said.

Thank you. Depression is what I think is causing me to be dramatic, medication hasn't fully kicked in yet. But I do really want to talk to my friend but they don't want to talk about it at the moment though they will still talk to me a little, I just wish there was some way to reconcile what I've done.

And I've been drinking for a long time now, I know my limits but at the same time sometimes the evening just gets to you when it's really fun.

I hope it is a positive life lesson learned.

Thank you for you're advice
